analytic_bounds.administrative_recovery_fraction_upper_b: Q_admin(t) <= 1 - exp(-0.0015 t), before affordability/decay restrictions

implication: The regeneration architecture contains at least a fast security-training mode and a much slower administrative-rebuild mode. A single context-invariant regeneration time constant is structurally disfavored before any 1440-day outcome is inspected.
guard: This is an analytic bound of the implemented synthetic mechanism, not an empirical claim about real states.
